summary: The frozen history test, read once, rejected every stock rule: Five Leaders in three forms and the household rule each beat only a small share of random baskets from this same list (rules_history.verdicts). Holding all names equally returned far more than the core; picking by past strength added nothing (rules_history.yardsticks). Setup checks and past strength show no demonstrated edge, and nothing here is expected to beat the index. Normal uptrend, narrow participation. All stances neutral, low conviction, paper only.

pick.thesis: Passes every setup check and is not stretched, so it meets the new-name bar on paper and is already a paper holding of the household rule. Its gap to the long average sits at the lower edge of the library's extended band, though. The frozen history test found setup checks added no edge over random picks, and a full score had no better outcome than a low one. Tied with Microsoft on the checks, which cannot break the tie. A candidate to track, not a call to beat the index.
risks: Setup checks and past strength showed no edge over random baskets on this list.
It trails the benchmark over the last month, and its recent swings are larger than the benchmark's.
A narrow market can rotate against a large leader together with the index.
One name carries single-company risk and a deep past drawdown.
pick.invalidation: Loses its trend check, drops below three of four setup checks, becomes stretched, or the next history read again shows no edge over random baskets.

pick.thesis: Three of four checks pass and it is not stretched, so it clears the new-name bar on paper. Its appeal is fit: very low link to the core and a different sector from the technology names. The case rests on one quarter of relative strength, it lags over the last month and half year, and its margin over the medium average is thin. A diversifier to watch, not a lean to own.
risks: Strength rests on one window; it lags the benchmark over the last month and the half year.
Trend margin is thin, so a small dip drops it to two of four checks.
It shares a sector and a fairly high link with Amgen, another household rule holding.
Low market link means mostly company-specific risk, such as a single drug result.
pick.invalidation: Falls to two or fewer setup checks, drops below its medium average, or turns stretched.

pick.thesis: Passes all four checks and the flag reads not stretched, but that flag only tests the medium average. Its gap to the long average is past the extended band in the library, and the strong last quarter followed a flat year that trailed the benchmark. Not eligible as a new entry; the paper holding is a mechanical rule output. Watch only.
risks: A start this far above the long averages raises the odds of a retest, according to the library.
Deep one-year drawdown, so volatility can return fast.
Shares the technology sector with Apple, so it adds little diversification.
Past strength did not beat random picks in the frozen history test.
pick.invalidation: A calm consolidation that stays above the medium average while the gap to the long average narrows would allow a reconsideration; losing the trend check ends the case.

pick.thesis: A strong leader at its one-year high with intact trend, but the setup flags it stretched and it fails the calm check. House rules forbid chasing a stretched name, so it is a watch only, never a new buy. Leadership alone has shown no edge on this list.
risks: Stretched names often digest before any next leg.
High volatility and a very deep long-run drawdown amplify any pullback.
It may simply keep leading, and a neutral stance would miss that.
Past strength did not beat random baskets in the frozen test.
pick.invalidation: Reconsider only if the stretched flag clears and it again passes at least three of four checks after a period of digestion.

pick.thesis: Jumped sharply over the last month and is flagged stretched, passing only one setup check, with the highest short-term volatility on the list. House rules forbid a new entry, and a big move alone is no reason to buy or to bet against it. Longer windows still trail the benchmark. Watch only.
risks: Very high volatility means large swings in either direction.
Its half-year and year-long records against the benchmark are weak despite the recent jump.
The only catalyst on file is an unverified claim and should not drive any decision.
It could keep rising while we stand aside; the evidence gives no edge to predict that.
pick.invalidation: Revisit only if the stretched flag clears and it passes at least three of four setup checks with calmer swings.
